$comment: Customer (/website) design-system registry. The custglobal.css counterpart of src/components/ui/variants.js. Hand-maintained; tools/scripts/check-website-design.js validates it against src/styles/custglobal.css and the /website/dev showcase on every predev/prebuild, and emits src/config/websiteDesign.generated.json for the showcase to render. See docs/ui/website-design-governance.md.

sections.title: Foundation
sections.description: Brand red, surfaces, the ink ramp, the page wash, the scrollbar and the control-system metrics. Every value on this page flips with the theme button above.

sections.title: Controls
sections.description: The two button styles, every raw form control custglobal.css styles, and the notice banner.

sections.title: Selects & Dropdowns
sections.description: WebsiteNativeSelect (live and open), the raw select fallback and the shared Dropdown API as it renders under the customer scope.

sections.title: Date & Time Pickers
sections.description: WebsiteNativeDateTimeInput triggers, the calendar and time-picker surfaces, and the Calendar API opt-outs.

sections.title: Marketing Page
sections.description: The .ws-* family behind /website: navigation, hero, typography, cards, grids, reviews, team, contact, footer and the Live Preview editor outlines.

sections.title: Vehicle Stock
sections.description: /website/available-stock and /website/stock/[reg]: filters, toolbar, vehicle cards, gallery, buying panel and specification.

sections.title: Shop, Basket & Checkout
sections.description: The #shop teaser, product tiles, the basket drawer, the cart and checkout layouts.

sections.title: Parts Catalogue
sections.description: /website/parts-catalog and the product detail page: breadcrumbs, basket notices, catalogue controls and the PDP.

sections.title: Sign-in & Account Forms
sections.description: /website/login: the auth card, fields, errors, the sign-up panel and the dev impersonation card.

sections.title: Valuation Wizard
sections.description: /website/valuation: progress, questions, answer groups, the DVLA result and the estimate.

sections.title: Help & Advice
sections.description: The Help & Advice cards and the More info popup.

sections.title: Customer Portal
sections.description: /website/profile: header and jump-to rail, cards, item rows, badges and VHC lights, the health ring, progress and tracker, money and mileage, media, messages, service tiles and the settings switch.

sections.title: Token & Coverage Reference
sections.description: Every token custglobal.css declares with its dark and light value and the value live on this page, plus every @family with its class count and recorded debt. Generated from the stylesheet, so it cannot go stale.

coverageExemptFamilies.showcase: The website-dev-* classes ARE the showcase page; they are rendered by definition.
coverageExemptFamilies.dev-overlay: Developer tooling, not customer UI: re-skins the staff dev layout overlay (src/components/dev-layout-overlay/) when it runs on a /website route. Every selector is anchored on the overlay's own data-dev-overlay-* attributes, so it cannot reach a customer page; it is exercised by typing /website-dev on any website page.

inheritedStaffTokens.--font-family: Deliberately shared: /website uses the same Inter-first stack the staff app loads once through next/font (theme.css). Re-declaring it would duplicate the stack and let the two drift.

--website-motion-duration.purpose: Shared customer transition duration; zero when reduced motion is requested.

--website-motion-easing.purpose: Shared easing for customer control and surface transitions.

--accentMain.purpose: Brand red. The one hex the accent derives from - change it together with --accentMainRgb.

--accentMainRgb.purpose: Brand red as an r, g, b triplet for rgba(var(--accentMainRgb), a) tints and glows.

--accentText.purpose: Accent used as text (prices, eyebrows, links). Reads --accentMain.

--primary.purpose: Legacy alias of the brand red. Reads --accentMain.

--primary-hover.purpose: Brand red, darkened - hover on primary fills.

--primary-pressed.purpose: Brand red, darkest - pressed primary fills.

--onAccentText.purpose: Ink on any solid brand-red fill.

--website-page-bg.purpose: The opaque page base under the wash (html / body / scrollbar gutter).

--surface.purpose: Opaque card fill - the Help popup card.

--website-wash-accent.purpose: The two brand glows in the page wash (top-right, bottom-left).

--website-wash-cool.purpose: The two cool-grey glows in the page wash (top-left, bottom-right).

--website-elev-1.purpose: Faintest lifted-panel wash (sign-up panel, showcase sections).

--website-elev-2.purpose: Standard glass-card wash (--ws-card, auth card, control material).

--txt-bright.purpose: Primary ink: headings, body copy, control labels.

--txt-mute.purpose: Muted ink: meta lines, labels, hints.

--txt-faint.purpose: Faintest ink: decorative only (off stars, fine print).

--website-placeholder.purpose: Placeholder text in select, date/time and dropdown triggers.

--website-input-placeholder.purpose: ::placeholder text in raw inputs and textareas.

--website-photo-ink.purpose: Ink on a photograph (condition pill) - fixed, photos do not change with the theme.

--font-family-base.purpose: Base font stack alias. Reads the shared --font-family.

--font-family-mono.purpose: Monospace stack (stock numbers, showcase code). Pinned here so the staff theme cannot change it.

--ghostbutton-ring.purpose: Legacy ghost-button outline shorthand (the capsules use inset shadows now).

--checkbox-ring.purpose: Radio / checkbox outline shorthand - border: var(--checkbox-ring).

--focus-ring.purpose: Keyboard focus halo (a box-shadow value, never a border).

--separating-line-color.purpose: Colour half of the row-separator pair, pinned to the brand red.

--website-control-height.purpose: 44px floor shared by every button, field, trigger, option row and banner.

--website-control-radius.purpose: Corner radius of the banner. Every control uses the 999px pill.

--website-control-font-size.purpose: Label size on every button, field, trigger and link-button.

--website-control-padding-x.purpose: Inline padding inside a text control or capsule.

--website-control-glyph.purpose: Glyph size inside an icon-only circle control (×, −, +, ‹ ›).

--website-radius-pill.purpose: Every control: buttons, fields, triggers, option rows, chips.

--website-radius-panel.purpose: Floating panels and in-card panels (menus, calendar, notices).

--website-radius-tile.purpose: Small tiles and media wells inside a card.

--website-radius-dialog.purpose: Dialog-scale cards: the Help popup and the sign-in card.

--ws-control-bg.purpose: The secondary control material: a near-opaque --surface tint on every non-primary control.

--ws-panel-bg.purpose: Denser --surface tint for floating panels: dropdown lists, calendar / time picker, mobile menu, basket drawer and summary.

--website-drawer-shadow.purpose: Lift cast by the basket drawer onto the page.

--website-on-accent-wash.purpose: Count badge sitting on a solid accent fill (active tab, basket button).

--website-banner-bg.purpose: Notice banner fill: the accent-tinted glass gradient.

--website-banner-shadow.purpose: Notice banner specular, hairline and accent glow.

--website-popup-scrim-tint.purpose: Brand-red wash over the page behind the Help popup.

--website-popup-scrim-base.purpose: Darkening base under the Help popup's red wash.

--website-popup-shadow.purpose: Lift under the Help popup card.

--website-chip-shadow.purpose: Lift under the Live Preview section label chip.

--website-success-rgb.purpose: Positive status green as an r, g, b triplet for rgba() tints (Paid badge, green VHC light) and the solid light dot.

--website-warning-rgb.purpose: Amber status as an r, g, b triplet: the amber VHC light tint and dot.

--website-danger-rgb.purpose: Red status as an r, g, b triplet: the red VHC light tint and dot.

--website-danger-ink.purpose: Negative / open ink: form errors, open badges, accent tags, debit amounts, red VHC light.

--website-accent-highlight.purpose: Bright start stop of accent gradients: tracker done dot, switch on-track, mileage bar.

--website-photo-shadow.purpose: Text shadow under captions laid over a photograph - fixed, photos do not change with the theme.

--ws-control-ring.purpose: 1px hairline drawn inset on the control material.

--ws-control-text.purpose: Label ink on the control material.

--website-selected-bg.purpose: Selected row in a custom menu (native select list, Dropdown API).

--website-selected-hint.purpose: Secondary hint line on a selected row.

--website-day-muted.purpose: Calendar days outside the visible month.

--website-day-disabled.purpose: Calendar days that cannot be picked (weekends, out of range).

--website-overlay-shadow.purpose: Drop shadow under floating surfaces: menus, calendar, time picker.

--website-specular.purpose: Thin top highlight on glass cards.

--website-scrim.purpose: Dark scrim behind the popup and under the photo condition pill.

--website-success-ink.purpose: Positive figures (valuation factors that raise the estimate).

--website-preview-rgb.purpose: Live Preview editor outline colour as an r, g, b triplet (staff-editor chrome inside the iframe).

--ws-card-soft.purpose: Soft card fill (media wells, chips). Reads --website-elev-4.

--ws-line.purpose: Hairline on .ws-page (card rings, table rows, nav rule).

--ws-tint.purpose: Tinted section band and quiet fills on .ws-page.

--ws-nav-h.purpose: Navigation bar height (also the scroll-margin offset).

--ws-nav-gap.purpose: Maximum gap between the bottom of the top bar and the first page content, on every /website page.

--ws-btn-radius.purpose: CTA corner radius. Overwritten inline from the Website Manager design row.

--ws-logo-h.purpose: Logo height. Overwritten inline from the Website Manager design row.

--ws-section-pad.purpose: Vertical section padding. Overwritten inline from the Website Manager design row.

--ws-nav-position.purpose: sticky / static navigation. Overwritten inline from the Website Manager design row.

--ws-heading-font.purpose: Heading typeface. Overwritten inline from the Website Manager design row.

--ws-popup-gap.purpose: Viewport gap around the Help popup card (mirrors the staff --popup-viewport-gap).

--surface-rgb.purpose: Staff token re-declared on the dev overlay root so staff overlay components render on the customer dark material.

--text-1-rgb.purpose: Staff token re-declared on the dev overlay root (overlay ink as a triplet).

--text-1.purpose: Staff token re-declared on the dev overlay root (overlay ink).

--text-2.purpose: Staff token re-declared on the dev overlay root (ink on the accent).

--theme.purpose: Staff token re-declared on the dev overlay root (tinted layer).

--accent-base.purpose: Staff token re-declared on the dev overlay root (brand red).

--accent-base-rgb.purpose: Staff token re-declared on the dev overlay root (brand red triplet).

--accent-strong.purpose: Staff token re-declared on the dev overlay root (strong brand red).

--checkbox-ring-color.purpose: Staff ring colour re-declared on the dev overlay root (switch outline).

--dev-overlay-control-bg-hover.purpose: Dev overlay compact control fill, hovered.

--dev-overlay-on-accent.purpose: Dev overlay ink on a solid accent fill.

--dev-overlay-label-bg.purpose: Dev overlay section label chip fill.

--dev-overlay-label-bg-hover.purpose: Dev overlay section label chip fill, hovered.

--dev-overlay-label-shadow.purpose: Dev overlay section label chip lift.

--dev-overlay-switch-bg-hover.purpose: Dev overlay switch track, off and hovered.

--dev-overlay-pill-bg-hover.purpose: Dev overlay category pill fill, hovered.

--dev-overlay-pill-selected.purpose: Dev overlay category pill fill, selected.
